decision: Preserve the completed ten-case E1 confirmation and its no-defect scientific outcome. Defer CHECKED-IMPORT-REGRESSION-PACK-1 because there is no demonstrated consumer need or incremental regression value, and reconsider it only when a concrete use justifies it. Keep ASSURANCE-CLAIM-DISPOSITION-1 READY and unstarted as an available independent visibility output. Do not execute either successor, launch more confirmation, add cases or build packaging infrastructure.

categories.assessment: The bounded E1 method answered its fixed question without an unexpected result. Additional integration would not add demonstrated scientific information; the separate disposition companion remains a distinct non-executing evidence-reconciliation method.

Preserve the exact manifest, raw receipts, portable replay and runtime identities. They remain usable if a future concrete consumer emerges, but current unresolved eta/recursor custody and transfer questions are not reasons to package these known cases.

No maintainer request, upgrade workflow or incremental regression need has been demonstrated. Defer the integration package and make no upstream write; the companion remains available for status clarity only.

Retaining the confirmed bytes and portable replay captures current reuse value without another command or distribution layer. The companion can reuse existing snapshot and ledger evidence if separately selected later.

There is no technical blocker to the package; it is deliberately deferred for lack of demonstrated value. ASSURANCE-CLAIM-DISPOSITION-1 is locally feasible and remains READY, but this owner handoff explicitly stops before executing it.

candidates.rationale: Keep READY and unstarted as an independent visibility output. It can account for published cases without checker execution, but this handoff does not authorize starting it.
No demonstrated consumer need or incremental regression value. Reconsider only when a concrete use justifies integration, distribution or usability work.
